title: Dell Couldn't Fix This Laptop. A Penny of Copper Tape Did.

author: Salem Techsperts
description: Dell Inspiron Touchpad Fix! Thousands of owners have complained about the touchpad on the Dell Inspiron 16 7610 gaming laptop. My customer had Dell replace the motherboard twice and the issue still happened. The problem was the grounding pin for the touchpad not making a good connection due to the PCB coating. All you have to do is either sand it off with sandpaper, or lightly buff it like I did here. Then stick a conductive piece of metal in between so it makes a good connection and grounds out. Before, the ohms were registering 20, now they register 0-0.5ohms. Weird repair, good results.
